The record for 5B.4 is mostly reform-oriented, but still incomplete and state-heavy.\n\nSearch gap: I did not find strong 2024 evidence on direct property-rights enforcement, land/title reform, contract-enforcement reform, or entrepreneurship-specific legal changes beyond the IMF/World Bank program language and SOE/tariff actions.
